source_title: Brand-New PlayStation Game for 2027 Leaked Online
source_excerpt:
A recent leak hints at a brand-new PlayStation game in development at Bend Studio, the creator of Days Gone , expected to be a co-op project launching in 2027. The PlayStation game will be the first new release from Bend Studio since the launch of Days Gone in 2019.
While Bend Studio has been largely quiet in recent years, the developer was once a mainstay on PlayStation consoles. As Eidetic and later under the Sony Computer Entertainment umbrella, Bend Studio helped to create the Syphon Filter series, which was met with critical acclaim and saw multiple Syphon Filter games on the PS1 , PS2, and PSP. Bend Studio's last major release was the 2019 zombie action game Days Gone , which, despite receiving middling reviews from fans and critics, sold more than 7 million copies. Now, Bend Studio may be preparing a comeback with a brand-new game.
Bend Studio is Reportedly Working on a New Game
Speaking to MP1st , an anonymous Bend Studio employee shed light on what the studio has been working on. The game is set to be a third-person, co-op experience that reportedly won't be a live-service title, with no mention of whether it will be a new IP or an adaptation. The mystery game is also said to be "much further along in development" than people might expect, following the reported cancellation of multiple games from Bend Studio in 2025, including a live-service game that was codenamed "Mirror Pond." The anonymous employee also hinted at the game's release window, claiming it will be both announced and released in 2027.
Though the Bend Studio employee did not confirm any details about the game's branding, it is not expected to be from the Days Gone universe. The developer had pitched a sequel to Days Gone to Sony following the first game's release, though the poor performance of the first game is said to have contributed to the proposal's rejection. Director Jeff Ross has previously gone on record as saying that Days Gone will never receive a sequel from Sony, due to executives at the studio not being keen on the game.

An official new game from Bend Studio would be the first word from the studio in over a year. Days Gone Remastered received its most recent update in October 2025 with the release of the 1.036.180 patch, which made the game playable when using the PlayStation 5's Power Saver mode. The game has not received a major content update since April 2025, with the release of the Broken Road DLC for Days Gone Remastered , which added the new Horde Assault and Permadeath game modes. Bend Studio has not made any announcement about its rumored new project.
Bend Studio's new release is set to join some major games already slated to hit the PS5 in 2027. Sony will kick off the year with the return of Until Dawn in January, seeing developer Firesprite officially release the long-awaited Until Dawn 2 on January 28. The newest God of War game is also scheduled to debut early in the year, with the February 16 debut of God of War: Laufey serving as the first time in the franchise that Kratos will not be the protagonist. Sony looks to have exciting things in store for the PS5 in 2027, and Bend Studio's newest game will add even more to the lineup.
